bio: Full-Stack Developer × Product Builder × Problem Solver

relay.description: 📱 Share your phone's internet with your PC — Android → Windows reverse tethering over an encrypted WireGuard tunnel. No root, no server, no account.

flow.description: 🪨 One decision a day. ⏱ Focus. 🌱 Habits. 🔒 100% offline.

sooda.description: 💎 Sooda — Liquid-glass profit, price & discount calculator. Offline-first PWA, bilingual (EN/FA), zero dependencies on servers.

nava.description: 🍎 Nava: The Art of Reduction. A Jony Ive inspired productivity app with Squircle design, Haptic feedback & Breathing animations. | نوا: مینیمالیسم محض؛ هنرِ حذف اضافات.

purify.description: 🧹 Clean your Windows disk with confidence. Fast, private, reversible cleanup built with Rust and Tauri.

overrun.description: A browser arena shooter that installs like an app, plays offline, and takes eight people online. Co-op waves, 4v4 team deathmatch, 2v2v2v2 squad royale. Zero asset files.

mova.description: Mova  in motion, not in perfection
